name: course-keeper
description: Checks a coding session against the project's vision and the person's standing instructions, and alerts the person when it deviates.

visionFile.title: Vision file
visionFile.description: The file that holds the vision, as a path relative to the root of the repository (the main working tree), or to the project root outside a repository. An invalid path counts as VISION.md.

antiPatternsFile.title: Anti-patterns file
antiPatternsFile.description: The optional file that holds the acts to avoid, as a path relative to the same root as the vision file. An invalid path counts as ANTI-PATTERNS.md.
